programme.title: SkywatchTV - Do The Jesuits Control The Deep State
programme.desc: How much influence have the Jesuits had on American history—and does that influence continue today In Part 2 of this fascinating three-part series Joe Horn continues his conversation with award-winning filmmaker and historian Chris Pinto about his documentary American Jesuits A History of Jesuitism in the United States Together they explore historical claims surrounding the Jesuit Orders presence in America examining their role from the earliest colonies through pivotal moments in US history The discussion also looks at the relationship between religion politics medicine and ideology asking whether connections exist that many people have never considered In this episode youll discover • Why many early Protestants viewed the Jesuits as a significant influence in the New World • The historical context surrounding the American Revolution Abraham Lincoln and the Civil War • Claims regarding Jesuit influence on education politics and medicine • Discussions involving Karl Marx Adolf Hitler and other controversial historical figures • Why Chris Pinto believes these overlooked historical connections deserve renewed attention Whether you agree with these conclusions or are hearing these ideas for the first time this conversation offers a thought-provoking look at one of historys most debated religious orders and its alleged impact on America
